case_title: RIESEN, PABLO VS SIMMONS BEDDING COMPANY

docket_entries.description: SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,208.49 FILED BY RIESEN, PABLO AS TO DEFENDANT SIMMONS BEDDING COMPANY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-09-2007 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SIGNED SENT TO CT CORP SYSTEM AGT FOR SIMMONS BEDDING CO.
UPON RETURN OF THE MERCHANDISE, DEFENDANT SHALL TENDER PAYMENT OF THE JUDGMENT TO PLAINTIFF.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RIESEN, PABLO RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SIMMONS BEDDING COMPANY $1,208.49 PRINCIPAL, $40.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,248.49, THE COURT ORDERS RESCISSION OF THE PURCHASE. WITHIN 30 DAYS OF THIS JUDGMENT, PLAINTIFF RIESEN SHALL COOPERATE WITH DEFENDANT TO RETURN THE SUBJECT MATTRESS TO ITS POINT OF PURCHASE, OR OTHER LOCATION WITHIN SAN FRANCISCO, AS DIRECTED BY DEFENDANT, AND AT PLAINTIFF'S EXPENSE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
